design.preregistered: The switch rule was written down before any number existed: a cell replaces truncate / truncate only if its paired chunk-MRR gain is at least 10 percentage points and the 95% interval over instances excludes zero.

switch_rule.rule: mean paired gain >= min_gain_pp AND the 95% interval excludes 0

power.basis: two-sided paired test, normal approximation, 80% power at alpha 0.05, using the observed SD of the per-instance differences. The SD is itself estimated from 18 instances, and a t-based calculation would need slightly more.

repos.note: One to six instances per repository: these are descriptions, with no intervals and no tests.

unreachable.meaning: Gold hunks no indexed chunk overlaps. They are dropped from the chunk metrics, not scored as misses.

sweep_link.exclusion: rows with an empty outcome (a harness loss, mostly provider 429s) are excluded, not counted as failures

auc.reading: probability that a random ever-solved instance had a better retrieval rank than a random never-solved one; 0.5 is no relation

sweep_link.power_note: 18 instances: an interval of this width cannot separate a modest relation from none.

truncation.source: .claude/rules/open-questions.md, embedding truncation (measured over this repository, not the benchmark repositories)
